description: Hayli Gubbi Volcano, Ethiopia, Pre-Event and Co-Event InSAR Interferograms - November 2025 Eruption. is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This dataset contains pre-event and co-event Sentinel-1 InSAR interferograms capturing ground deformation associated with the Hayli Gubbi volcano eruption in November 2025 (Ethiopia). The pre-event interferogram shows background and precursory deformation, while the co-event interferogram highlights eruption-related displacement. These data enable analysis of eruption dynamics, precursory signals, and volcanic ground deformation. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are Hayli Gubbi Volcano, InSAR, Ground Deformation, Sentinel-1, Precursory Deformation. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
